name: cxDiscovery
oneLiner: Personalised inflight e-magazine plus vendor targeting.
reconnectTakeaway: State a second beneficiary (desk throughput), not only passenger care.

name: TouchCX
oneLiner: Passenger phone to crew tablet for amenity requests (NFC).
reconnectTakeaway: Win by sitting on a crew/agent device, not another passenger super-app.

name: Fight4Flight
oneLiner: Delay notification and re-planning from the passenger side.
reconnectTakeaway: Passenger-only re-plan loses. The desk is the missing 2017 piece.

name: Aviator
oneLiner: Dining and activity manager aimed at connecting passengers.
reconnectTakeaway: Connecting passengers are the moment; recovery is the job.

name: GME / Asia Miles visualiser
oneLiner: Map and proximity for Asia Miles partners, plus redemption notices. Public 2021 repo — not a press-named champion.
reconnectTakeaway: A cloneable repo is not a trophy. 2021 champion name is unpublished, same failure mode as 2018.

name: Cathay Green
oneLiner: Currency and AI to promote carbon offset and green practice.
reconnectTakeaway: Ryan Lam: first pitch ran out of time; finals presentation won. Narrate the buttons. Only claim ESG if we can count stranded nights.

name: NAAR cargo dimensioning
oneLiner: Computer vision to size cargo and pack denser, with less manual labour.
reconnectTakeaway: Lead with a number (minutes, pax, queue length). NAAR led with accuracy and labour.

name: GingTrip modular trolley
oneLiner: Modular galley trolley that sorts cabin waste and feeds a dashboard.
reconnectTakeaway: They lost in 2023, came back with a trolley (Andy Ng, CX 2024). We already have the typhoon button. Do not wait a year, and do not add a robot.

name: U-Explore (Kairos Takeoff Crew)
oneLiner: All-in-one HK Express customer-journey platform: loyalty, community, gamified content.
reconnectTakeaway: Do not copy the loyalty app. Copy the named BU and the lived pain sentence.

name: Niki Jr.
oneLiner: Polaroid robot named after CX DC-3 Niki; app booking, crowd-aware queueing.
reconnectTakeaway: Presentation award is theater. We already have buttons; narrate them.

name: FlyLab pre-flight briefings
oneLiner: AI summaries of existing pre-flight briefing packs for pilots.
reconnectTakeaway: Closest 2025 analogue. Pair with a transfer agent. Do not invent a new PSS.

name: Anita chatbot
oneLiner: Chatbot that reminds passengers before boarding.
reconnectTakeaway: Notify is not recover. We notify after an agent approves a protected flight.

name: Lugless
oneLiner: Bags packed and waiting at destination.
reconnectTakeaway: Bags are out of SCOPE. Do not add them before Saturday.

name: 2019 Hackathon (cancelled)
oneLiner: 24-hour event scheduled 9–10 Nov 2019 cancelled after a risk assessment (HK unrest). ~250 participants offered regional tickets.
reconnectTakeaway: Do not read 2023–2025 ops wins as a new law of nature. 2019 never ran. 2021 champion is unpublished.

name: Cathay First
oneLiner: Inflight personaliser: Facebook + Asia Miles, movie/song lists, dining, gamification. Not on the podium.
reconnectTakeaway: Personalisation lost to a crew workflow. Do not demo a content recommender.

name: Betsy
oneLiner: Travel concierge: boarding countdown, bill-split, personalised IFE. Not on the podium.
reconnectTakeaway: A countdown is useful. Ours is slack-to-MCT on the agent iPad, not a concierge clock.

name: Hacksmart
oneLiner: Itinerary planner with a conversational chatbot, route suggestions, Asia Miles offers. Not on the podium.
reconnectTakeaway: The 2023 GitHub corpus is Hacksmart with Azure. Judges have seen it for a decade.

name: Dean Fung (2021 2nd RU)
oneLiner: Second runner-up, 60+ teams. LinkedIn names the team, not the product. 2021 champion still unpublished in press.
reconnectTakeaway: Do not fill the 2021 champion cell with GME because GME has GitHub.

name: GingTrip (2023 attempt)
oneLiner: Andy Ng, 2024 press: they took part in 2023, learned from coaches, came back and won with the trolley.
reconnectTakeaway: They needed a year and a trolley. We already have the typhoon button. Do not wait.

name: Cathay-Cargo box sequencing
oneLiner: Python to sequence boxes; CV sizing; zip of UI. NAAR-adjacent, not the champion repo.
reconnectTakeaway: Participant GitHub is not how NAAR won. Do not chase stars.

name: CathayConnect
oneLiner: Azure OpenAI trip planner. README includes the full pitch script.
reconnectTakeaway: Steal the habit of a written pitch. Do not steal the ChatGPT planner.

name: ReservaCathay
oneLiner: ML overbooking plus GPT-personalised compensation offers.
reconnectTakeaway: Use this as the foil when a judge asks why we did not put GPT on ranking.

name: FlyMate (Skydreamers)
oneLiner: 2023 2nd RU + Best Innovation. Flutter GenAI app for travellers with disabilities. Public repo; NAAR still won.
reconnectTakeaway: A podium PRM app is not a desk. WCH +15 is already in mct.ts. Say the number; do not demo their chatbot.

name: Syd (ctrl+shift+elite)
oneLiner: React + OpenAI + DialogFlow travel buddy chatbot.
reconnectTakeaway: This is what 2026 BU judges are tired of.

name: TravelSync
oneLiner: Vue app: chat, hotels, airport transfer, Splitwise.
reconnectTakeaway: Do not add hotels to the Saturday demo.

name: PassportScanner
oneLiner: Scan passport to auto-fill online check-in. Pain: <30% online check-in.
reconnectTakeaway: A number in the pitch is good. PNR in LLM prompts is already constrained in the pilot note.

name: Carbon per passenger model
oneLiner: ML for carbon emissions per passenger per flight.
reconnectTakeaway: Theme-chasing without a desk owner is 2022, not 2026.

name: Optimal flight route (2025 repo)
oneLiner: Public 2025 repo: most optimal flight route. Not the student champion.
reconnectTakeaway: Search GitHub for 2025 and you will not find Kairos. That is the point.

name: MILES+
oneLiner: Make unused Asia Miles a daily currency. Typical 2024 lifestyle repo.
reconnectTakeaway: A Cathay ledger is good. The transfer queue is the ledger we already have.

name: Talker (2018 PWA chatbot)
oneLiner: Vue PWA ‘to demonstrate a chatbot’. Same year Anita (chatbot) was first runner-up.
reconnectTakeaway: Chat as the product is an eight-year-old participant default.

name: CathayDelight
oneLiner: 2018 public repo. Empty README. Typical of the participant corpus.
reconnectTakeaway: An empty repo from the year we cannot name the champion is the corpus, not the bar.

name: EvoGreen
oneLiner: GreenPoints + AI itinerary planner + eco inflight options. Public 2025 repo; not Kairos.
reconnectTakeaway: Search 2025 GitHub and you get EvoGreen or a route optimiser, not U-Explore or FlyLab.

name: SMASH waste dashboard
oneLiner: Streamlit dashboard + AI to track HK Express flight waste. Same BU as GingTrip; GingTrip won with a trolley.
reconnectTakeaway: Same pain, weaker theater. Our typhoon button is the trolley. Keep it on stage.

name: SyncCart
oneLiner: Connected galley carts: Socket.IO fleet state, tablet UI, barcode, ops dashboard. Hardware-adjacent.
reconnectTakeaway: Crew-device + live fleet state is the shape. We already have it on the iPad without a cart.

name: All IT Dragon
oneLiner: Google Maps/Places for attractions and restaurants at the destination after landing.
reconnectTakeaway: Landing is our moment too. The job is the missed outbound, not dinner.

name: Cathay World (metaverse assistant)
oneLiner: Flask + OpenAI travel assistant; airport questions redirect into a Unreal ‘Cathay World’.
reconnectTakeaway: If a judge asks why we did not build a world, this is why not.

name: FlyVision AaaS
oneLiner: AWS S3 + Rekognition computer vision. A year after NAAR won cargo dimensioning.
reconnectTakeaway: Do not rebuild NAAR. We already have a desk. Add theater to it, not a second CV demo.

name: Good Trip (Team 100)
oneLiner: Flutter app from a Figma template. README is design-system boilerplate, not an airline pain.
reconnectTakeaway: A polished UI without a desk sentence is the default. Do not demo like this.

name: Amadeus Passenger Recovery
oneLiner: Mass reaccom: >50 flights and 8,000 pax in 40 minutes. CX live since ~2018 with Accenture chatbots and 15below.
reconnectTakeaway: Pitch beside this tool. Never instead.

name: CX typhoon programme (Rogers 2019)
oneLiner: Josh Rogers: 100,000 customers when the hub closes; wanted airborne reprotect on inflight Wi-Fi.
reconnectTakeaway: Our CX254 +180 demo is the 2019 wish, on a desk iPad.

name: United ConnectionSaver
oneLiner: Holds the outbound using walk time; SMS with minutes. 3.3 million connections saved since 2019.
reconnectTakeaway: Encode walk + WCH + UM now. Hold-the-flight is LATER. Know the map.

name: NASA Open MCT
oneLiner: Web mission-control glass: telemetry, timeline, mobile, one place.
reconnectTakeaway: Queue + connection + action drawer is already one glass. Say mission control, not dashboard.

name: SpaceX flight software culture
oneLiner: Control cycle on a clock; config DSL for non-software engineers; sim + HITL; no LLM in the loop.
reconnectTakeaway: packages/engine is already this shape. Pitch it that way.

name: amadeus-disruption-agent
oneLiner: LangGraph + Amadeus APIs. LLM phrases verified facts only. RAG for EU261.
reconnectTakeaway: Cite reasoning[] the way they cite policy passages.

name: AutoRescue
oneLiner: AWS Bedrock + Amadeus search for cancelled-flight rebooking.
reconnectTakeaway: Live Amadeus is impressive. Decision authority is not transferable to Saturday.

name: HKG A-CDM
oneLiner: TOBT/TSAT shared clock for turnaround. Missing passenger is an A-CDM delay reason.
reconnectTakeaway: Never use the iPad wall clock. FIDS eventTime / sim clock only.

name: Reconnect (this repo)
oneLiner: Deterministic MCT engine + iPad triage + guarded draft. Pilot: Altéa read, FIDS MQTT, CANS push.
reconnectTakeaway: The product is already the 2026 feasibility shape. The pitch must not throw it away.

name: Accenture Rebooking Experience
oneLiner: CX self-rebook chatbots in the typhoon stack: notify, then four steps to pick a preferred flight.
reconnectTakeaway: Chatbot self-rebook is already bought. Our send is agent-approved CANS, not a second bot.

name: 15below customer communication
oneLiner: Notification layer on CX disruption: once a new journey is accepted, 15below sends the new flight details.
reconnectTakeaway: CANS after human confirm sits beside 15below, not over it. Do not pitch a new notification platform.

name: Sabre IROPS Reaccommodation
oneLiner: Mass rebook + reseat + ancillaries on Sabre PSS. Refreshed STX product: 2× faster on large disruptions.
reconnectTakeaway: Mass IROPS is a purchased category at every major PSS. We are not in that category.

name: Amadeus Self Re-accommodation
oneLiner: Passenger accepts the auto-rebook, picks an alternative, or refunds — same business rules as Passenger Recovery.
reconnectTakeaway: CX already wants agents on the hard cases. That is the desk. Do not add a second self-rebook bot.

name: Plan3
oneLiner: PSS-agnostic overlay: bundle flight + hotel + meal voucher; passenger self-serves. Sabre partnership 2023.
reconnectTakeaway: Holistic care is a vendor category. Do not bolt hotels onto the Saturday iPad.

name: HK Express Navitaire New Skies
oneLiner: HX live on Navitaire New Skies + SkyLedger since 2015. Not Altéa. HX app also talks Amadeus + Navitaire APIs.
reconnectTakeaway: GingTrip/U-Explore attached to HX. We attach to CX transfer. Do not pretend one PSS write covers both.

name: HRS Crew & Passenger Solutions
oneLiner: Hotels, ground transport, meals, photo-receipt reimbursement when IROPS hits. Sabre deal 2023.
reconnectTakeaway: Count fewer stranded nights only if we measure them. Until then, omit ESG. Care vendors already exist.
